Uncle Grisha, this is very suspicious.

This is actually not a bad option.
Fine, let's hear his offer.

present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.text: Это самый лучший вариант для всех.
examples.trans: This is the very best option for everyone.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

meanings.note: много дел = a lot to do
